note: Curated editorial roster of the City of Chicago's published bikeway-network commitments, with citations, kept separate from anything OYL measures itself. It exists to pair against OYL's own snapshot-built `site/data/bikeway_mileage_series.json` so readers can see the promise next to the network as it stands today. Delivery-since-2023 is NOT measurable from OYL data: the CDOT Bike Routes layer carries no install-date field, so the mileage series is built forward from snapshots (first snapshot 2026-07-11) with no way to attribute miles to when they were built. A FOIA requesting per-segment install / as-built dates from CDOT is drafted and ready to send: docs/outbox/2026-07-12--foia--cdot--bikeway-mileage-history.md (item 4). Only commitments with a direct citation below are listed; nothing here is inferred or estimated.
